title: Dillinger's Wooden Gun Escape
caption:
He broke out of an "escape-proof" jail with a gun made of wood. 🔫

Then he took the sheriff's own car, and made one mistake that changed everything.

Criminal genius, or an inside job? Tell us below 👇

scenes.say: He broke out of an escape-proof jail with a wooden gun. Crown Point, Indiana. March 3, 1934.
John Dillinger, America's most famous bank robber, was awaiting trial for killing an East Chicago police officer.
Weeks earlier, he'd posed with the prosecutor's arm draped over his shoulder. The photo wrecked the prosecutor's image.
Officials boasted the jail was escape-proof. Dillinger stayed just over a month.
That morning, he pulled a small black pistol. It was wood, reportedly darkened with shoe polish.
The deputies raised their hands. Guards and prisoners were locked inside the cell block.
Then he demanded the fastest car around: the sheriff's own Ford.
He sped to Chicago with two hostages, then let them go unharmed.
But crossing into Illinois in a stolen car was a federal crime. Now federal agents could hunt him.
Less than five months later, agents shot him dead outside a Chicago theater.
He claimed he carved it himself. Some say it was smuggled in. Genius, or inside job? Tell me in the comments.

characters.dillinger: white man aged 30, average build, dark brown hair slicked back with a side part, clean-shaven, sly half smile, 1934 vest over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers
characters.estill: heavyset white man in his 50s, receding grey hair, round glasses, dark 1930s double-breasted suit and tie
characters.sheriff: white woman in her 40s, dark hair pinned up, 1930s dark dress with a sheriff's star badge
characters.deputy: white man around 40, 1930s grey county jail deputy uniform and peaked cap, ring of keys on his belt
characters.agent: lean white man in his 30s, dark fedora, long dark overcoat, 1930s federal agent

shots.prompt: Dramatic close-up of [dillinger] inside a 1934 jail corridor, holding a small blackened wooden pistol at his chest, iron cell bars behind him, harsh single bulb light, defiant smirk
shots.action: [dillinger] slowly raises the small black wooden pistol, the bare bulb above swinging gently and shadows sliding across the bars

shots.prompt: Wide shot of a grim red-brick 1930s county jail and courthouse in a small Indiana town on a cold March morning, bare trees, a black Ford parked outside
shots.action: Cold mist drifts past the brick jail walls as the camera glides slowly along the building

shots.prompt: Medium shot of [dillinger] in a crowded 1934 courtroom, reporters with flash cameras behind him, wooden benches, sunlight through tall windows, he looks relaxed and confident
shots.action: Reporters lean forward and flash bulbs pop as [dillinger] turns his head slowly and smiles

shots.prompt: [estill] standing beside [dillinger] for a press photo in a 1934 jail office, the heavyset man's arm draped over the robber's shoulder, both smiling, photographers with big flash cameras in the foreground
shots.action: A press camera flash bursts and both men hold their smiles as smoke from the flash bulb drifts upward

shots.prompt: Close-up of a 1934 newspaper front page lying on a desk showing a photo of two smiling men arm in arm, a coffee cup and a gavel beside it, morning light
shots.action: The newspaper slides slowly across the desk and comes to rest beside the gavel

shots.prompt: Long empty jail corridor in 1934 with thick steel bars and heavy locks, [deputy] patrolling with a ring of keys, cold blue light, an air of total security
shots.action: [deputy] walks slowly down the corridor, his keys swinging, as light flickers over the steel bars

shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot inside a 1934 jail: [dillinger] pressing a small black wooden pistol into the back of [deputy], who freezes in shock, tense stillness, hard side light
shots.action: [deputy] slowly raises both hands as [dillinger] steps closer behind him, holding the small black pistol low

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of a crude hand-carved wooden pistol stained black with shoe polish, a razor handle for a barrel, lying on a rough wooden table under a lamp
shots.action: The camera slowly circles the small wooden pistol as dust floats through the lamp light

shots.prompt: Wide shot of a 1934 jail cell block: guards and prisoners in striped shirts being herded into a large barred cell, [dillinger] holding the door, dim overhead lamps
shots.action: The barred cell door swings shut with a slam as the guards inside step back from it

shots.prompt: [dillinger] striding out of a jail garage toward a black 1933 Ford V8 sedan, hat pulled low, early morning sun, small-town street behind
shots.action: [dillinger] walks quickly to the black Ford, pulls open the door and slides behind the wheel

shots.prompt: A black 1933 Ford V8 speeding along an empty two-lane country road through flat Midwest farmland in late winter, dust trailing behind, wide shot
shots.action: The black Ford races down the country road, kicking up a long trail of dust behind it

shots.prompt: Low angle on a weathered 1930s road sign at the Indiana-Illinois state line, a black Ford speeding past it, grey sky, ominous mood
shots.action: The black Ford roars past the state line sign and disappears down the road

shots.prompt: 1934 federal agents in fedoras gathered around a desk under a hanging lamp, studying a wanted poster and a map of the Midwest pinned to the wall, cigarette smoke
shots.action: An agent slides the wanted poster across the desk while cigarette smoke curls under the lamp

shots.prompt: Night street in 1934 Chicago outside a glowing movie theater marquee with bright bulbs, [agent] waiting in the shadows of a doorway, crowds leaving the theater
shots.action: Theater lights twinkle as the crowd spills onto the sidewalk and [agent] steps slowly out of the shadows

shots.prompt: Museum-style close-up of a small black carved wooden pistol displayed on velvet under a spotlight, a 1934 mugshot of [dillinger] blurred behind it, mysterious mood
shots.action: The spotlight slowly brightens over the wooden pistol as the camera pulls back from the display
